links.outcome: Share of outcome variance attributable to agent harness and model-harness interaction
links.effect: Harness and its interaction with the model account for about a quarter of outcome variance; no single harness is best across models and tasks.
links.quote: We find that the harness and its interaction with the model account for about a quarter of the outcome variance, and that no single harness is best across models and tasks.

unlisted_practices: Controlled comparison of agent harnesses holding the model fixed, with ablation of individual harness mechanisms (context management, planning, tool exposure)

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM agents on medical tasks, specifically testing deployment/scaffolding practices by isolating agent harness mechanisms (context management, planning, tool exposure) with and without specific configurations across models.

primary.practice: agent harness mechanisms (context management, planning, tool exposure)
